section_intro: This section narrates DEF-A, the exact corner of the amended definition: T → 0, t_m → ∞, write work W = 0, E_b → ∞, with "admissible" read as [U,H] = 0. Its entry point in the Universal Record Model is ProjectModel.corner. This header carries no number, no row and no carrier mark of its own: everything the corner layer asserts is in a block below, where five cells govern it and replicate/check_proof.py can reach it, so a reader quoting this layer should quote a block and not this paragraph. Read each block's tier off its own rows cell, which prints every row's registered status and T-9 carrier mark and which that gate checks against ledger/status_ledger.tsv and LANE_T9_AUDIT/T9_carrier_audit.tsv. FORMAL is real mathematics about the program's own stipulated clauses and says nothing by itself about whether the world's records satisfy them (H-3); DEFINED marks a stipulation, a convention or a definitional repair and not a theorem; MEASURED and PARTIAL are neither. No rows cell in this section prints PROVED. One block here carries a statement about the world and not only about the clauses: P-CORNER-1, whose scope holds the census behind O-51 and says whether that relation is measured or open. Each gate cell names the check that fires on its block or reads none, and where none is narrower than section 0.2's "no gate exists yet" — as it is for P-CORNER-5 — the scope cell says why. Every number in this section comes from a sealed lane or a validator run named in its block's grounding cell; where a block has no URM entry point, its scope cell says so.

claims.headline: def-a is the verified limit of the amended definition, not a second definition
claims.prose: DEF-A is the corner of the amended clauses at T → 0, t_m → ∞, write work W = 0 and E_b → ∞, with admissible read as [U,H] = 0. With no dissipation the slow modes of the Liouvillian at t_m → ∞ are exactly the commutant of {I, H, L_k, L_k†}: ProjectModel.corner returns the slow-mode count and the independently computed dimension Σ_E m_E² together and compares nothing itself — the comparison is the gate's, and there the two agree at 96 = 96 on [[4,2,2]], 1536 = 1536 on [[6,4,2]], and 24 = 24 on the three-qubit Ising chain. Clause (ii′) reduces to clause (ii) with the record's decay rate and ‖[H,R]‖ both 0.00e+00; the dissipative control is what makes those zeros a measurement, since at finite t_m the slow set is monotone in t_m and strictly smaller than the commutant, 1 of 2 at t_m = 1e9 s and at 1e3 s. Durability is |λ| ≤ 1/t_m and not |Re λ|: with no dissipation −i[H,·] is anti-Hermitian, so a |Re λ| filter excludes nothing, and an observable at λ = iω does not decay but rotates, so its value oscillates.
claims.grounding: LANE_T28_LIMIT/t28_limit.txt (sealed; three carriers with the dissipative control, dims 96/1536/24); reproduced through the URM's single entry point at model/validate_project.py, 14 PASS / 0 FAIL
claims.scope: A statement about the program's own definition: DEF-A is a genuine corner of the amended clauses. It says nothing about the world, and on that point the program has a measured answer and not an open question — the census behind O-51 tested ~20 real records against these exact clauses, and zero satisfy them. Verified on three finite-dimensional carriers with unitary or Hermitian generators; the reduction is not established for infinite systems. The other two carriers are carried by the sibling gates T-28 corner [[6,4,2]] and T-28 corner 3q Ising in the same file, whose names are the run-time values of one loop f-string. This block restates P-DEF-5 at the head of the corner section; it is the same result and not a second confirmation of it.

claims.headline: the corner carrier must declare itself at the urm's public gate
claims.prose: D-25 is enforced at the URM's public gate. URM.surface refuses to build a corner-tier carrier unless the caller passes provenance='DEF-A', and refuses a world-tier surface that carries no provenance at all; both refusals are raised ValueErrors and both are tested by the validator in the failing direction. The exact idealisation therefore cannot silently pose as a real record surface at that gate. The gate covers what is built through it: the sealed lanes this section narrates predate it and construct their carriers directly, so no claim below is marked at construction time.
claims.grounding: model/VERIFY_T46 (sealed adversarial check of the T-46 build); the PROVENANCE registry in model/project_model.py, whose own comment records that sealed lanes predate this gate and use the raw class; pinned external anchors in LANE_T41_EXTERNAL/CITATIONS.md
claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — The guard is a tool refusal that constrains how the model may be called; it establishes nothing about physics. It checks that the caller declared a tier, not that a declared DEF-A carrier is in fact a corner carrier. RecordSurface holds thermal parameters (dE, E_b, T, f0), so it cannot hold a DEF-A (H, {L_k}) carrier at all, and URM.surface is called nowhere in the repository outside the three validator gates — the only corner-tier call is the one written to raise. This restates P-DEF-7's gate for the corner tier and adds no new result.

claims.headline: when a corner record exists, and why the naive converse is false
claims.prose: For Hermitian R, [L,R] = 0 iff [L†,R] = 0, so clause (ii) places R in the commutant of the *-algebra alg{I, H, L_k, L_k†} and not merely in the commutant of the set {H, L_k}. A record non-trivial on the eigenspace E_λ exists exactly when the compression P_λ A P_λ is a proper subalgebra of B(E_λ). A record satisfying (i)–(iv) exists exactly when that commutant contains a projection that is non-trivial on some eigenspace of H and trace-balanced; the criterion was compared against direct evaluation of the clauses on 210 constructed systems with zero disagreements, 105 of which admit a record and 105 of which do not, so both outcomes occur in quantity. The naive converse is false: degeneracy alone gives (i)–(iii) and gives neither compatibility with {L_k} nor flippability, and under a generic perturbation clause (ii) is violated at first order, slope 1 across six decades, with 0 records found in 200 trials at each of ε = 1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2 and 1e-1.

claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — The equivalence is about clauses (i)–(iv) only; clause (v) has no referent in (H, {L_k}) and is not evaluated. The 210-system verification is a finite family — D ∈ {4,6,8}, every unordered noise block structure, energies drawn from {0,1,2} — and corroborates the theorem without extending it. The ε-sweep is reported only above ε ≈ 1e-5, where the surviving commutant directions are distinguishable from float noise. The gate fires on the converse half alone, at one 4-dimensional H with one generic jump; the D-15 control that makes its zero a measurement is the sibling check in the same file, the same H with a diagonal jump, which P-DEF-10 names and narrates. Neither the criterion-against-clauses agreement on 210 systems nor the ε-sweep is gated anywhere, and model/validate_model.py is outside the two validators section 0.3 names; it is run by replicate/on_finding.sh.

claims.headline: writability at the corner is exactly trace balance on every eigenspace
claims.prose: With admissible read as [U,H] = 0, an admissible U satisfying U†RU = −R exists exactly when Tr(P_E R) = 0 on every eigenspace of H; record_model.clause_iv evaluates that trace directly and build_writer returns the explicit block-swap unitary when it vanishes. Clause (i) makes R an involution, so the corollary is immediate: in an odd-dimensional Hilbert space Tr R is odd and no record there is ever writable, and the URM returns zero records at C^3, C^5 and C^7. The zeros are measurements because the unbalanced case sits in the same table — an unbalanced involution's best ‖U†RU + R‖ over 4000 random unitaries is 2.0000, the exact bound, and the sweep never returns below 2.000116, against 0.000e+00 for the constructed writer. The equivalence is carrier-free and was checked on nine spectra: every record the model built is balanced on every eigenspace, and an admissible writer was built and verified on the first eight records of each spectrum, 8 of 210 at the largest.

The gate named here fires on the odd-dimension corollary only, at C^3, C^5 and C^7 through one loop f-string; the trace-balance equivalence itself, the nine-spectrum table and the 2.000116 floor are gated nowhere, and model/validate_model.py is outside the two validators section 0.3 names. The sealed file behind the nine-spectrum table is a truncated crash capture: nothing this block cites was cut off, since the abort follows Part A, but the file is not a completed run and belongs in the reproduction-debt inventory. The competing reading, "generated by the theory's own operators", is refuted: clause (ii) puts every generator in R's commutant, which makes clause (iv) unsatisfiable for every record — 400 random words return 2.27e-15 and the toric carrier 0.00e+00, against 32.00 for the real writer as the positive control. The remaining disjunct, "or a physical channel", is untested.

claims.headline: clause (ii) is a condition on the environment, not on the record
claims.prose: A record exists only where the environment's couplings commute with it, so clause (ii) constrains the noise. On the toric 2×2 carrier, no noise leaves 256 minimal projections and single-site Z noise leaves 32, both admitting records, while generic single-site X, Y, Z noise collapses the Hermitian commutant to dimension 1 — scalars only — and admits no record at all. The Z-noise column is the control that makes the collapse a measurement: the same instrument returns records where they exist. The same pair of outcomes repeats on the non-manifold [[8,1,2]] carrier and on [[4,2,2]], which is not a lattice at all. Both configurations are re-run through the URM inside model/validate_formation.py, which asserts records under single-site Z noise and scalars only under single-site X, Y, Z noise; both checks pass in that file's 17 PASS / 0 FAIL run.

claims.scope: The claim is that generic single-site noise admits no record on the three carriers tested; it is not a proof that every noise model outside that family admits none. Dimension 1 is the Hermitian commutant's dimension computed at the module's stated numerical tolerance. Citing them takes a one-line change in the validator; until it is made this block is gated in fact and ungated in the contract, and the count of ungated blocks in section 0.3 counts it as ungated. That validator is also outside the two section 0.3 names; it is run by replicate/on_finding.sh.

claims.headline: what carries the corner record: em supplies both boundary maps
claims.prose: At the corner the carrier is a lattice gauge field: ∂₁ is the Gauss law and ∂₂ the plaquette term, so the record space is the homology of EM's own chain complex, Z₁/B₁. The identification is exact on the torus family — dim Z₁ = 5, 7, 10 and dim B₁ = 3, 5, 8 at 2×2, 2×3 and 3×3 while dim H₁ = 2 throughout — and "satisfies the Gauss law" agrees with "lies in ker ∂₁" on all 256, all 4096 and all 262144 link configurations. The record, its writer, and the minimal coupling that can form it are the same kind of object: an EM holonomy on a non-contractible cycle. The object is neither local nor the whole system — absolute extent d = L grows without bound, the record fraction 2/(L²+1) vanishes, and local content is exactly zero, against which 8 of the 252 weight-2 Paulis do distinguish code states, all 8 logical, which is the control that makes the weight-1 zero a measurement.
claims.grounding: LANE_X6_CONSTRAINT_ALGEBRA/x6c_cohomology.txt (sealed); LANE_EM_EXTENT/em_extent.txt (sealed); LANE_F7_OCCUPANCY/f10c_whatformsit.txt (sealed); LANE_W62_CREATION/w62_creation.OUT.txt (sealed; the writer measurement — transport around a non-contractible cycle, with contractible-loop and single-link controls)
claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — ProjectModel.roles reports the registered role sentence and computes nothing; the numbers are the sealed lanes'. Every measurement here is on the toric torus family, so "EM" names this lattice gauge carrier and not the electromagnetic field of the world. The extent statement is a property of these operators, with closed forms checked against exact GF(2) ranks at L = 2..5 and evaluated out to L = 256. The record/writer/coupling identity is A-EM3, which is three separate measurements — Theorem B(ii), W-62's transport, f10c's weight-2 census — arriving in the same class on that one carrier; it was not designed in, and three same-kind measurements on one carrier are not corroboration on a second.

claims.headline: at the corner the topology supplies the record space, the writer and the protection
claims.prose: Γ names the third term by the function it performs: on a closed orientable surface of genus g it supplies the record space 2^{2g} — a count that is 2g and does not move with the area of the lattice, 2 at area 4 and 2 at area 6 — a writer that is not local, and the protection. On the canonical benchmark that protection is manifold homology with no semantic caveat — across 1480 regions at L = 3..6 on the toric code, contractible regions carrying a logical operator: zero; non-contractible: all of them, 27 of 27 at L = 3 and 80 of 80 at L = 4, which is the control that makes the zero a measurement. dim(V(Rg) mod S) equals rank χ(V(Rg)) for every one of those regions. Aut(carrier) = 8L² exactly, so the carrier is not permutation-symmetric and contains geometry for the instrument to detect.

ProjectModel.roles reports the registered sentence and computes nothing. The 1480 regions are rectangular plaquette blocks at every position, contractible and wrapping alike, and not every region of the lattice; what carries the census past that family is the identity dim(V(Rg) mod S) = rank χ(V(Rg)), verified region by region, under which a region contained in a topological disk has H₁ = 0 and therefore carries no logical operator. The record space 2^{2g} is C-5, whose registered owner is BORROWED — Kitaev's degeneracy and its area-independence, restated in record vocabulary — and the area-independence is two lattice sizes of the one carrier, not two carriers. The clause (v) census and the Aut count are what is registered from the O-50 lanes; that lane group's separate writer-invariance candidate was self-certified PROVED by three of its four lanes and all four adversaries independently returned it not proved, and it is not relied on here. P-DEF-6 states the 1480-region census in one clause; the increment here is A-GR's three-role packaging, the Aut count and C-5's area-independence.

claims.headline: homology is not necessary, and capacity is not protection
claims.prose: Records with verified admissible writers exist in systems with no tensor factorisation into qubits, no stabiliser group, no cells, no homology and no geometry: 5 of 5 constructed systems, including two at dimension 6 carrying 4 records each, with a writer built and checked in every system. The necessary condition is the commutant criterion of P-CORNER-3 and nothing narrower. Capacity survives off manifolds — the Z₂ gauge degeneracy equals 2^{dim H₁} on pinch-point complexes, on a pure graph and on two tori wedged at a point, 8 = 8, 4 = 4 and 16 = 16, while the surface law 2 − χ fails on 7 of those 11 carriers. Capacity and protection are independent: a bouquet of k triangles has dim H₁ = 2, 3, 4 with true code distance d = 1, against the L×L torus at dim H₁ = 2, 2, 2 with d = 2, 3, 4.
claims.grounding: LANE_T12_NECESSARY/t12_necessary.txt (sealed); LANE_G10_NONMANIFOLD/g10_nonmanifold.txt (sealed, six self-checks PASS; the SURFACE column reads FAILS on seven of the eleven carriers and the INDEX column HOLDS on all eleven); LANE_PF3_ADMISSIBLE2/pf3c_twodistances.txt (sealed)

A writer was built and verified in all five systems, and for every record in four of them; the dimension-8 system had 4 of its 8 records checked. The "7 of 11" figure corrects a slip the ledger still carries: G-10's ITEM and REGISTER_V001.md:5135 both write "6 of 11" while line 5135 names all seven failing carriers — disk 3×3, theta graph, bouquets of 2, 3 and 4 triangles, two wedged tori, abstract complex — and the sealed table agrees with seven. Only the SURFACE column of that table is quoted here; its INDEX column, dim H₁ = dim H₀ + dim H₂ − χ, holds on all eleven carriers and is G-7, registered PARTIAL and carrying its own caveat that it is the capacity law only. The capacity/protection independence rests on a row registered at MEASURED, not FORMAL, and it carries its own erratum — the earlier table's d = 3, 3, 3 was the Z-systole alone, and true d = min(systole, cosystole) = 1.

claims.headline: the erratum to clause (v): admissible was never optional
claims.prose: As first written, clause (v) carried no admissibility restriction and was false of the program's own canonical carrier: a single-edge X on (0,0,H) satisfies X†RX = −R exactly. With admissible inserted the censuses return zero: 0 admissible flippers over the 36 certified-contractible regions at L = 3 — every plaquette, every star and every single edge, the 27 rectangular plaquette blocks among the 63 candidates having been rejected as winding — against 1158 single-region Paulis that do flip R, counted with region multiplicity over 1062 distinct operators; and 0 over the 300 certified-contractible regions at L = 5, largest |T| = 24, admitted from 475 candidates of which 175 wind, against 2.815e15. The positive control is the point, and both counts are exact by F₂ linear algebra, since both sets are subspaces and the count is 0 or exactly half. A second implementation reproduced 1158 and 0 by brute-force symplectic enumeration over all 4^|T| Paulis with no shared code, and two further controls fire on that same routine: it registers 1 flipper on a winding region, and 123 when only the plaquette half of admissibility is dropped. The minimum-weight admissible writer at L = 3 has weight 3 = d and is a product of three single-edge operators each individually inadmissible, ‖[X_e,H]‖ = 45.255, so the record is written by an operation that is admissible only as a whole. Clause (v) is the one clause the model refuses to guess: RecordModel.protection raises NotImplementedError and supplies no default locality structure, so every claim resting on (v) inherits and names a carrier.
claims.grounding: LANE_O4_VERIFY/verify_o4.txt and verify_o4b.txt (sealed; the independent brute-force reproduction of 1158 and 0, the winding-region control at 1, the plaquette-half control at 123, the 1062-distinct-operator recount, and the DEF-A′ escape failing the case its own docstring names); LANE_O4_ADMISSIBLE/o4_L3.txt (sealed; the candidate-region tables and their rejections at both sizes, and the L = 5 census — 300 certified-contractible regions, largest |T| = 24, 0 admissible flippers against 2 815 050 556 581 770 any-Pauli flippers) and o4_toric.txt (sealed; ‖[X_e,H]‖ = 45.255 and the single-edge witness)
claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — A definitional repair to the program's own clause, confirmed by censuses on the toric code at L = 3 and L = 5. The counts are exhaustive over every operator inside each region and over a declared family of region shapes — plaquettes, stars and single edges at L = 3, and rectangular plaquette blocks up to 3×3 as well at L = 5 — and not over every contractible region, so this block does not by itself settle clause (v) for region shapes outside that family; the general statement on the torus is P-CORNER-7's homological one, that a region contained in a topological disk has H₁ = 0 and therefore carries no logical operator. It also fixes the reach of P-3, which is C-13: no admissible writer fits inside one contractible region, and the strong reading "nothing local can write it" is false, since clause (v) quantifies over single regions and never over products while d local terms do reach the record. DEF-A has no working fallback: the registered DEF-A′ escape was a miscount, and corrected it fails the very case its own docstring says it rescues.

claims.headline: the 1d ring is a boundary-constrained proxy; the torus is canonical
claims.prose: On an open 1D chain the whole carrier is one contiguous block, so clause (v) fails: the smallest region whose admissible operations flip a record is exactly w = n at every n = 3..14 for both coupling sets, and the operator at w = n is X^⊗n with ‖[U,H]‖ = 0.0e+00, U†Z₀U = −Z₀ exactly, dE = +0.000000, flipping all n records at once. The zeros below w = n carry their controls: cutting the chain by setting one coupling to zero drops the smallest flipping region to the size of the smaller component — 3 at n = 8, 4 at n = 10, 5 at n = 12 — and H = 0 gives w = 1, while the exact criterion over every unitary supported on a region agrees with an exhaustive Pauli search on 630 cases with zero disagreements. For 1D rings only, the program adopts the standard QEC locality constraint, under which a contractible region is a proper sub-region with diam(R) < L, and clause (v) holds on the ring with distance n. That reading is a decision of the principal's, it is labelled a proxy wherever it is used, and the canonical benchmark is the toric code, where the logical operators have genuinely non-contractible support, both distances scale with L, and no semantic caveat about "contractible" is required.

claims.headline: clause (v) on the non-abelian carrier, by an exact integer obstruction
claims.prose: On D(D₄) over the 1×2 torus, dimension 4096, the admissible single-edge algebra on each contractible region is span{I, T} with T right-multiplication by the central r², and the eigenspace traces t_E = Tr(P_E T) = {30, −48, 12, 0, 6} are not all zero. Because they are not all zero, no record of any kind — constructed or not, transport-fixed or transport-moved — is flipped by any admissible unitary on any contractible single-edge region, and the u-edges give zero balanced class patterns likewise. The mechanism is the group's own non-abelianness: r² lies in [D₄, D₄], characters kill it, and conjugation fixes classes. The test discriminates, which is what makes the zero a measurement — the abelian D(Z₂) control on the same lattice fails clause (v), since X_{h0} is an admissible weight-1 flipper of a clause-verified record, and the non-admissible positive controls flip exactly.
claims.grounding: LANE_T24_DV/t24_main.txt and LANE_T24_DV/t24_z2.txt (sealed; verifier not-refuted at high confidence, with every verdict-bearing number re-derived by fresh independent code)
claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — Scoped as its row scopes it: a boundary-constrained proxy at L_y = 1, which is exactly what degenerates the abelian plaquettes and makes the control fail, so the stated mechanism is what a larger lattice must be tested against. Protection is transport-blind at this proxy size, since the obstruction quantifies over all admissible involutions. The Wilson-character diagonals fail clause (iv) on this carrier and the character-times-class family contains no records, so those are three-clause objects and the record constructions go through eigenspace splittings. There is no model function and no validator gate: the URM implements no quantum-double carrier and no admissible single-edge algebra, so this computation lives only in the sealed lane. The row is audited — LANE_T9_AUDIT/T9_carrier_audit.tsv returns SINGLE-CARRIER (DD4), recording the D(Z₂) run as a discriminating control and not as support on a second carrier.

claims.headline: clause (iv) on d(g) needs even eigenspaces, and the obstruction is |g|'s order
claims.prose: Clause (i) makes a record an involution, so Tr(P_E R) = dim(E) mod 2, and clause (iv) requires that trace to vanish on every eigenspace: every eigenspace must be even-dimensional. That necessity is general over D(G). What the carriers supply is the diagnosis. The total dimension of a D(G) carrier on E edges is |G|^E, a power of two exactly when |G| is, and across seven carriers every group order carrying an odd factor produced an odd eigenspace and left clause (iv) unsatisfiable, while every power-of-two order left it satisfiable — and on D(Z₂) and D(D₄) records are exhibited, not merely unobstructed. The controls separate the two explanations that S₃ alone confounds: abelian Z₃ at order 3 has multiplicity [9] at the minimal carrier, odd, and admits no record, while non-abelian D₄ at order 8 has multiplicities [22, 24, 18], all even, and does. Z₃ and S₃ fail at both carrier sizes tested. The obstruction is the group's order, and the commutativity of the group plays no part in it.
claims.grounding: LANE_O35_NONABELIAN_CARRIER/o35_carrier.txt (sealed, 7 carriers with both discriminating controls in the same table)
claims.scope: The parity necessity — clause (iv) on a D(G) carrier requires every eigenspace to be even-dimensional — is general. The other direction is not: the lane establishes that clause (iv) is unobstructed on the power-of-two carriers, and records are actually constructed only on D(Z₂) and D(D₄). C-41's registered quantifier over all D(G) is therefore wider than the computation, a scope the program's own classification pass flagged, and it travels with this claim wherever it is quoted, section 7 included. The verification is seven carriers over five groups — Z₂ at 1×2, Z₃ at the minimal complex and at 1×2, Z₄ at 1×2, D₄ at the minimal complex, S₃ at both. The statement is about clauses (i)–(iv) and says nothing about protection on those carriers.

claims.headline: clause (iii) forces degeneracy, and the definition itself discriminates
claims.prose: Clause (iii) asks R to be non-constant on some eigenspace of H, so that eigenspace has dimension greater than one: (iii) ⟹ H is degenerate, in one line and with no further hypothesis. record_model.clause_iii evaluates the clause directly as the maximum deviation from a scalar on each eigenspace, and record_model.eigenspaces supplies the blocks it runs on. The clause earns its place because the definition as a whole discriminates, and that is this section's control for DEF-A itself: on the toric-code record all five clauses pass — (i) 0.00e+00, (ii) 0.00e+00, (iii) 4.899, (iv) 0.00e+00, (v) 11.314 — while two near-misses run on the same instrument fail exactly where they should.
